interactives.label: Rules of the causeway
interactives.text: One party at a time. The brood comes to you; the causeway behind stays quiet once you have cleared it. Fall and you rise at the last fire you passed. The waystones count you out.

interactives.label: Waystone
interactives.text: The waystone home. Using it counts you out of the run.

interactives.label: The lotus steps
interactives.text: The priests came down these steps at dawn to cut lotus for the court. The lotus still grows.

interactives.label: The Sovereign's tithe-chest
interactives.text: The road's cache. It opens once for each of you when the court is quiet.
